capabilities: Generate X post drafts from selected note text
Generate LinkedIn post drafts from selected note text
Match your writing style from pasted voice samples and tone presets
Edit drafts in place with a live character counter
Reopen recent draft runs from history
disambiguation: Not a social media scheduler or auto-poster; it only generates drafts that you edit and copy yourself.
extras: Not yet in the community store, so the README gives manual install steps (npm build, copy files into .obsidian/plugins/postcraft/). Warns that the API key and draft history live in data.json inside the vault and should be kept out of any public sync or repo.
motivation: The author found most AI plugins are general-purpose chat and wanted a tool that does one thing: select text, run one command, get finished posts with no prompt writing.
problem: Obsidian has no one-click way to turn note content into finished social media posts; general-purpose AI plugins require writing prompts yourself.

relations.evidence: Calls Anthropic directly via Obsidian's requestUrl

summary: AI generator that turns selected note text into ready-to-post X and LinkedIn drafts matching your voice, using your own Anthropic API key.
